subject: Billing sender roles, archive retention, and e-invoice fallback
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta@acme-payments.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap@acme-payments.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice origin & delivery method (email until e-invoice ready)

Hi Jasmine,

Quick question from our AP team as we get set up with Redwood Inference: can you confirm whether Redwood will be the invoice originator (i.e., invoice sent from Redwood's billing address to Acme), or do you expect us to pull invoices from a portal? Our preference is to receive an automated e-invoice (SFTP/Peppol) but we can temporarily accept emailed PDF invoices while SFTP goes live.

Also: we need clear confirmation that VAT registration number will be on the invoice, and a statement about how long Redwood retains invoice records (our policy requires 7 years).

Could you attach a sample invoice and any XML schema for e-invoice so our integration team can validate?

Thanks,
Marta Alvarez
Head of AP — Acme Payments

(attachment: request_form_ap_onboarding.pdf)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@acme-payments.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice origin & delivery method (email until e-invoice ready)

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front:

- Redwood can be the invoice originator and will send legally-signed PDF invoices to your AP mailbox.
- We can also enable SFTP e-invoice delivery (we support Peppol and plain XML via SFTP).
- VAT reg number will be included on every invoice.
- Redwood retains invoice records for 7 years by default; we can provide a retention statement for your files.

Plan suggestion: we send the first two monthly invoices as PDFs to ap@acme-payments.com while we stand up the SFTP. Once SFTP is tested and approved we will switch to e-invoice delivery and keep email copies as a fallback (copies only, not the primary delivery). If that works for you we'll start SFTP credentials exchange.

I've attached a sample PDF invoice and the invoice XML schema we use (simple invoice + VAT fields). Ben, Karthik — can you confirm the onboarding checklist items below and whether we need to set up specific bill-to entity mapping for Acme?

Onboarding checklist (proposed):
- Confirm AP mailbox and billing contact (Marta) — ACTION: Acme
- Provide SFTP endpoint + test creds or Peppol ID — ACTION: Acme
- Redwood to send 2x PDF invoices as test — ACTION: Redwood (Jasmine)
- Run SFTP test and validate XML schema — ACTION: Karthik/Integration
- Confirm VAT evidence (cert or reg number) on invoice — ACTION: Redwood (Ben)

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Billing Operations — Redwood Inference

(attachments: sample_invoice_202708.pdf, invoice_xml_schema_v2.xml)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice origin & delivery method (email until e-invoice ready)

Looping in a few details from the billing side. A couple clarifying items for the Acme setup:

- Bill-to entity: do we have a specific legal entity for Acme to bill? If Acme has multiple subsidiaries, we need the remit-to and VAT mapping.
- PO requirements: do you require a PO number on the invoice to trigger payment? If so, please confirm the PO format (e.g., ACME-#####).
- Currency and SEPA/BACS instructions: please confirm preferred currency and whether bank details should include IBAN/SEPA mandate.

I'll prepare a minimal retention statement we can drop into our onboarding packet. Also attaching the current XML schema excerpt we'll send during SFTP tests. Karthik, please plan to run the test next week; I'll schedule a short handshake.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

(attachment: invoice_xml_schema_v2.xml)

From: Marta Alvarez <marta@acme-payments.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap@acme-payments.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 08:41:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice origin & delivery method (email until e-invoice ready)

Thanks — those options work. A few confirmations from our side:

- We prefer SFTP e-invoice as the long-term primary method. We'll provide SFTP endpoint and temporary credentials by EOD today to your security inbox (ap-inbound@acme-payments.com).
- We'll accept emailed PDFs as a temporary fallback for the first two invoices.
- PO requirement: yes, our AP system requires a PO number on the invoice for automated matching. PO format will be ACME- followed by 6 digits.
- VAT: please include Redwood's VAT registration number and the VAT breakdown line items on every invoice.
- Retention: 7 years is fine — please provide a short signed retention statement for our auditors.

I'll attach a small SFTP test checklist our team uses (credentials, connect test, checksum). Once we complete the test can we agree to flip the primary delivery to SFTP within 5 business days?

Best,
Marta
Head of AP — Acme Payments

(attachment: sftp-test-instructions.txt)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@acme-payments.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice origin & delivery method (email until e-invoice ready)

Thanks everyone — quick MAP (mutual action plan) to close this out:

1) TODAY: Acme to send SFTP endpoint + test credentials to ap-inbound@redwood.ai (Marta).
2) 2027-08-27: Redwood will push two sample PDF invoices to ap@acme-payments.com (Jasmine).
3) 2027-08-30: Redwood Integration (Karthik) will run SFTP connect + XML validation using invoice_xml_schema_v2.xml.
4) 2027-08-31: If SFTP test passes, Redwood will switch primary delivery to SFTP and continue to send email copies for 30 days as a fallback (Ben).
5) 2027-09-01: Redwood to provide signed invoice retention statement (PDF) and VAT registration line to include on invoices (Ben).

Open items: please confirm the legal bill-to entity name and PO workflow. If PO numbers will always be provided, we will include a PO field on every invoice and add the automated matching note.

I will create a shared folder with the test artifacts and invite Acme's AP team. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/acme/invoice-samples

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

—Karthik
Head, Integrations — Redwood Inference

(attachments referenced: sample_invoice_202708.pdf, invoice_xml_schema_v2.xml, sftp-test-instructions.txt)
